entities.summary: "Lolly" is a song by American recording artist and record producer Maejor Ali. The song, released as a single on September 17, 2013, features vocals from American rapper Juicy J and Canadian singer Justin Bieber. The song peaked 19 on the US Billboard Hot 100 chart. This is the first commercial song in which Justin Bieber raps.
